hooks.command: [ "$(git branch --show-current)" != "main" ] || { echo '{"block": true, "message": "Cannot edit files on main branch. Create a feature branch first: git checkout -b feat/FR-X.X-description"}' >&2; exit 2; }
if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -q '\.py$'; then ruff check --fix "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null || true; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | grep -q 'models/.*\.py$'; then MODEL_NAME=$(grep -oP "_name\s*=\s*['\"]\K[^'\"]+" "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$MODEL_NAME" ]; then ESCAPED=$(echo "$MODEL_NAME" | sed 's/\./\\./g'); if ! grep -q "$ESCAPED" addons/aslabot/security/ir.model.access.csv 2>/dev/null; then echo "{\"feedback\": \"WARNING: Model '$MODEL_NAME' has no entry in ir.model.access.csv. Add security rules before committing.\"}" >&2; fi; fi; fi
